description:
Whether the cited paper's own sentences support what a sentence
    attributes to it: supports, partly supports (a condition is missing),
    contradicts, or not addressed, with the single best sentence from the
    paper quoted. Call this before citing a paper for a specific claim, or to
    check a citation in a draft or an answer. It reads the paper's abstract,
    and its full text where Pith holds it; the examined field says which. On
    real citations its verdict agreed with two blind model families 139 times
    in 160, most differences being partly supported versus not addressed
    (https://pith.science/connected-record).
